meta.title: Request a Quote for Fresh Fish from Egypt
meta.description: Send your seafood requirement to AZAFCO's export team: species, size, packing, volume and destination. Quotes are confirmed per request.

hero.title: Send your request from your company email or WhatsApp
hero.intro: We reply to requests sent from a company email address or a business WhatsApp number, and we confirm the buyer before we quote. Open the prepared message, complete the blank lines and send it.

short_hero.corporate_intro: For partnerships, investment or other business topics, written from your company email. No product details needed.
short_hero.documents_intro: Ask from your company email for product specifications, certificates or the company profile. We confirm what can be shared for your request.

aside.title: What happens after you write to us
steps: The export team reviews your requirement against current availability and the specification.
We contact you to confirm the details and any open points.
If we can supply, you receive a formal quotation. Price, quantity, packing and terms are confirmed in it.
aside.no_promise: Sending a request does not commit you or us to an order. Prices and availability are confirmed only in a written quotation.
prepare: Volume per shipment and how often
aside.attach_text: Attach your specification or packing sheet to the email if you have one.
